integrity.proof_type: finite exhaustive discrete-Morse matching, exact integer attaching vector, exact Lefschetz and rational character computations
integrity.reproducibility: Python 3.9+ standard library; all matching faces and group actions generated from graph definition

scientific_limitations: Applies only to the ordinary matching complex of the twelve-vertex graph C3 Cartesian C4.
The nonequivariant sphere-wedge equivalence is not claimed to be equivariant.
Geometric quotient homology assertions use rational coefficients, not integral coefficients.
Complete verification of unindexed/unpublished prior work is not possible; no independent audit has been performed.
title: The matching complex of \(C_3\square C_4\): forty-four three-spheres and its full row-column character
